# Connector actions (reference)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:gen` from server/core/actions (HTTP and Email providers). Do not edit by hand. -->

Built-in actions of the action connectors. Custom actions of an HTTP connection (made with the form or imported from
OpenAPI) are listed on the connection's Actions tab. How actions run, the limits and the error codes:
[docs/dev/connectors.md](../dev/connectors.md#connector-actions); for makers:
[connections and actions](../guide/maker/connections-and-actions.md).

| Connector | Kind | Actions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTP (REST API) | `http` | `request` |
| Email | `email` | `send` |

## Error codes

| Code | Retryable | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_input` | no | The inputs do not fit the action's schema (or a template value is missing). |
| `not_found` | no | The connection or action does not exist. |
| `denied` | no | Not allowed (attachment the identity cannot open, every recipient suppressed). |
| `blocked` | no | Outbound policy: host not on the allow-list, a forbidden address, a refused redirect. |
| `rate_limited` | yes | The connection's rate or concurrency limit, or the remote answered 429. |
| `circuit_open` | yes | Calls are paused after 5 failures in a row (30 s, doubling to 5 minutes). |
| `timeout` | yes | No answer within the time limit. |
| `network` | yes (not for TLS) | Connect, reset or certificate problems. |
| `upstream` | 5xx yes, 4xx no | The remote answered with an unexpected status. |
| `too_large` | no | The response, the output or the inputs are above the caps. |
| `limit` | yes | An email sending limit of the environment. |
| `in_progress` | yes | The same idempotency key is running right now. |
| `not_configured` | no | A secret or setting of the connection is missing (or OAuth refused the client). |
| `unavailable` | yes | The server cannot do it now (email not set up). |

## Actions

### HTTP (REST API): `request` (Send an HTTP request)

Calls the API of this connection: a path relative to the base URL (or a full address on an allowed host), with query, headers and a body. The connection adds its authentication.

Idempotent: no. Side effect: external (a flow must pass an idempotency key; a repeated key returns the stored result for 24 hours). Time limit: 30 s.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `HEAD` |  | Method Default `"GET"`. |
| `path` | string |  | For example /orders/{{id}} (placeholders come from Path values) or a full address on an allowed host. Default `""`. |
| `pathParams` | object (names to string or number or boolean) |  | Values for the {{placeholders}} of the path (each is URL-encoded). |
| `query` | object (names to string or number or boolean or array) |  | Query |
| `headers` | object (names to string or number or boolean) |  | Headers |
| `bodyType` | `none`, `json`, `text`, `form` |  | json (default for objects), text, or form (URL-encoded fields). |
| `body` | any |  | Body |
| `expectStatus` | list of integer |  | Statuses that count as success (default: any 2xx). |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | integer |  | HTTP status code |
| `headers` | object |  | Response headers (lowercase names; cookies are not returned) |
| `body` | any |  | The answer: JSON as data, text as text, anything else base64 |
| `url` | string |  | The address that answered (after redirects) |

### Email: `send` (Send an email)

Sends an email through the install's mail relay, with copies, a reply-to address and attachments. Suppressed addresses are skipped.

Idempotent: no. Side effect: external (a flow must pass an idempotency key; a repeated key returns the stored result for 24 hours). Time limit: 30 s.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | string (email) or list of string (email) | yes | One address or a list. |
| `cc` | list of string (email) |  | Cc |
| `bcc` | list of string (email) |  | Bcc |
| `subject` | string | yes | Subject |
| `text` | string |  | Plain text body (made from the HTML when left out). |
| `html` | string |  | Rich body; scripts, styles and event handlers are removed. |
| `replyTo` | string (email) |  | Reply-to |
| `attachments` | list of object |  | Attachments |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mailId` | string |  | The entry in the email delivery log |
| `recipients` | integer |  |  |
| `suppressed` | integer |  | Recipients left out because they are on the suppression list |
